process_values.label: First-pass ship
process_values.description: Complete gate once; avoid multi-deploy fix storms.

process_values.label: Polish threshold
process_values.description: High on public flagships and object-hero stills; concept without museum finish is a miss.

process_values.label: Register before style
process_values.description: Classify planet/mode before inventing visual direction.

process_values.label: Evidence over vibes
process_values.description: Update graph from scored outcomes and explicit feedback.

collaboration_protocol.title: Classify
collaboration_protocol.instruction: Pick emotional register / surface class before inventing style.

collaboration_protocol.title: Load nodes
collaboration_protocol.instruction: Apply matching density, color, motion, and non-negotiable antis.

collaboration_protocol.title: Distance check
collaboration_protocol.instruction: New work must not clone the nearest sibling planet. Prefer distinct worlds.

collaboration_protocol.title: Prove once
collaboration_protocol.instruction: If multi-modal, show variants. Ship with complete gate. Log outcome to evidence_log.

north_star: One signature object or moment, register-true density and color, motion that informs, zero effect soup - across a solar system of distinct planets owned by a sovereign craft operator.
